run.title: Whole run

settings.title: OneDrive settings
settings.keys: ↑↓ select · Enter toggle · ←→ change a number · Esc back
setting.showPercentInBar.hint: The progress figure next to the cloud while syncing
setting.showBarProgress.hint: A thin line under the icon during a long run
setting.showRunCard.hint: Files done and time left, only for runs longer than the threshold
setting.runBarMinSec.hint: Shorter runs show only the current file
setting.showTransferCard.hint: The file being transferred, with its own progress
setting.showSyncDetails.hint: Last sync, last cycle, tally, interval and folder
setting.showStorage.hint: Used and total space, asked from Microsoft
setting.recentLimit.hint: How many files the list holds
setting.showActions.hint: Folder, restart, check and storage buttons
setting.notifyOnFailure.hint: A desktop notification when a sync cycle fails or the client logs an error
setting.startAtLogin.hint: Enables the onedrive user service so it starts with the desktop
setting.openConfig.hint: Open ~/.config/onedrive/config in your editor; restart to apply
setting.openSyncList.hint: Choose which folders sync (sync_list); restart to apply
setting.reauth.hint: Stops the service, re-authenticates in a terminal and starts it again
update.upstreamOnly: %1 released upstream, AUR package not updated yet
action.update.hint: Install onedrive-abraunegg %1 from the AUR in a terminal, then restart the service
setting.checkUpdates.hint: Asks aur.archlinux.org and api.github.com every few hours. Nothing is installed without you.
setting.updateCheckHours.hint: How long a check result is trusted before asking again
setting.checkUpdate.hint: Compare the installed package with the AUR and the upstream release
setting.installUpdate.hint: Runs yay in a terminal (asks your password), then restarts the service
